div.div: هَجَاجَةٌ , (K,) without the art. ال, (TA,) or رَجُلٌ هَجَاجَةٌ, (S,) and ↓ هَجْهَاجٌ and ↓ هَجْهَاجَةٌ , (K,) A stupid, or foolish, man; one of little sense: (S, K:) and the first, one who consults not any one, but follows his own judgment whether he err or take a right course: (Sh:) or without heart and without intellect or intelligence: (AA in TA, art. رع:) and the second, a rude, coarse, or churlish, and stupid, or foolish, man: (K:) and the third, a man of much evil, or mischief, and of little understanding: or, accord. to AZ, of no understanding, and of no judgment. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
